#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    if (!(std::cin >> s)) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Input error");
    }
    int ans = 0;
    int i = static_cast<int>(s.length()) - 1;
    while (i >= 0) {
        int j = i - 1;
        while (j >= 0 && s[j] == s[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        if ((i - j) % 2 == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
        i = j;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
